title: Escaping contract from a round contract
statement: Let $R$ be a round contract for a machine with anchor state $a$ and escape set $E$, and suppose the state $a$ is not in $E$. Restrict the precondition to starting configurations whose specified endpoint state belongs to $E$. With the same running times, endpoints, and head bounds, this gives a contract with entry state $a$ and exit set $E$: from every such start in state $a$, the computation reaches the endpoint at the specified time, its state belongs to $E$, the computation avoids $E$ at all earlier times, and the head bounds hold throughout.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
An escape set of optional states
The anchor state is not in the escape set
The starting configuration satisfies R's precondition and starts in the anchor state
The specified endpoint state belongs to the escape set
